items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: I see Wilbur down there, and he has tears coming down... I said, 'What's the matter, Wilbur?' 'I lost Sidney, my brother.'

ctx.x: Sidney. I was down at the union to collect some money, some checks or something, and I see Wilbur down there, and he has tears coming down... I said, "What's the matter, Wilbur?" "I lost Sidney, my brother." After that... After him, he took all the (?) out, and he just give it up. He had a good band, though.

But when I did (?) kind of singing... You mentioned earlier the "Saints" recording date. As fast as I could play. But it was the first time when I... How fast can you play (?). You can play as fast as you wanted to. [PATS A STEADY FOUR] See, that's my speed. So I took four bars, was going... [SINGS RAUCOUS TEMPO]
